purpose: P7 acceptance on held-out captures nobody has looked at; everything below is fixed before the data exist

candidate.description: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 kNN, bank of 4 clean train captures + severity-1 augmentation, geometric ROI (geometry v2), 24 px score margin incl. image border, diffuse gate (spread), surface rule k=3

baseline.description: PatchCore v1 WRN50 (locked), same ROI/margin (no image border)/gate/surface rule

data.never_used_for: training, calibration, development or label tuning

criteria.definitions: robustness/acceptance.py docstring; pooled over all conditions and all held-out captures; recall over observable physical defect occurrences (defect x capture x condition, >= 3 views); bootstrap over captures for uncertainty

map_B_labels: defect positions traced only from the held-out map B capture images (no detector output viewed), reviewed by the user and locked (sha256 recorded) before any detector is scored on map B
live: dashboard --v2-model runs on map A and map B after the offline report
no_changes: no threshold, bank, geometry, margin, gate or rule change after this registration; any change starts a new registration and needs new held-out data

map_B_labels_locked.note: traced from seed 105 images only, checked on seed 106, approved by the user before any detector ran on map B
